crossRefs.note: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

translations.web: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, listen now to this message I am speaking in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
translations.asv: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people:
